resources.string: Lossless and Hi-Res Lossless playback is still experimental and may not work correctly with every song for now. For now, Lossless and Hi-Res Lossless work only on Wi-Fi networks.
Automix is still experimental and may not work correctly with every song or transition for now. If your phone gets unusually warm or Android starts stopping Orb automatically, disable Automix.
